body: An action chunk can span several stages of a manipulation task, yet a label for its first step describes only the current stage. We introduce Chunk-Aligned Semantic Distillation (CASD), which derives semantic targets for entire action chunks. An offline vision--language model segments demonstrations into described stages. Their occupancy within each action chunk determines a weighted semantic target, including transitions between stages. A CASD generator learns to predict this target from the current observation, robot state, and task instruction. We then freeze the generator and train a policy conditioned on its predictions. The semantic branch runs once per policy query, without online VLM calls or reasoning-trace decoding. Teacher matching on annotated LIBERO training episodes is above chance for both single-stage and boundary-crossing chunks. We evaluate three Fast-WAM variants and a DreamZero integration across four benchmarks, including distribution shifts on LIBERO-Plus. Compared with published references, IDM+CASD reaches 98.9% versus 98.0% average success on LIBERO, while Uncond falls below its reference. Joint+CASD reaches 93.0% versus 90.6% on RoboTwin 2.0, and DreamZero+CASD reaches a 47.9% four-category MolmoSpaces manipulation average versus 40.7%. Performance varies across backbone integrations.
summaryZh: 该研究提出了一种名为CASD（Chunk-Aligned Semantic Distillation）的方法，用于解决机器人操作任务中，单个动作标签仅描述当前阶段而忽略整个动作块（Action Chunk）的问题。CASD利用离线视觉-语言模型（VLM）将演示分割为不同阶段，并根据各阶段在动作块中的占比计算加权语义目标。然后，一个CASD生成器学习从当前观测、机器人状态和任务指令预测该目标，并冻结生成器训练策略。实验表明，CASD在多个机器人操作基准测试中，相比现有方法显著提高了成功率，尤其是在处理跨阶段动作块时。

aiReview.reasonZh: 该研究提出了一种名为CASD的语义蒸馏方法，用于改进多阶段机器人操作任务中的动作块学习，通过对整个动作块而非单步进行语义目标推导，提升了机器人的操作成功率。

模型需要学习预测的目标表示，这里指与整个动作块含义相关的目标。
能够理解和处理图像与文本信息的模型。
指某个阶段在整个动作块中所占的时间或比例。
在强化学习或机器人控制中，指决定机器人如何行动的策略或函数。
